Issue Number: close #40123 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
1. Recognizes HashJoin and HashAgg pattern to decide if applying fine grained shuffle stream count
2. When pattern matched, get latest tiflash server count C, and minimal logical cpu cores M,  to roughly check if the optimization worth fine grained shuffle cost.

issue_context.title: Support fine grained shuffle join & agg for tiflash

review_comments: if `minLogicalCores` is 1, it will be treated as error?
Yes, while error will only lead to no join&agg fine grained shuffle.
Just copied from our TiFlash maxStream calculation: use actual available physical cores. And since no info can found here to infer the ratio of logical/physical, just use the most common 2 here.
agg don't need to use a new `aggHelper`, just reuse `helper` is enough. I think we can leave a todo here.
Maybe better way to add tiflash replica: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/executor/tiflashtest/tiflash_test.go#L87 ?
Yeah, just follow the other test code in the same file. Just keep them the same here:)
We may also consider disaggregated tiflash mode, the label of tiflash_compute nodes is `<engine, tiflash_compute>`
Good point, disable this for disaggregated tiflash mode by return unsupported error.
And we can also init `streamCountInfo` here?
DisaggregatedTiFlash is not supported because pd does not have related information?
It is still under design, especially for auto scaling.
When AutoScaler manage tiflash_compute nodes, PD cannot get the server info of tiflash_compute, we need add API in AutoScaler to support this.
